summary: Treat any obsolete Ghost Ship full-map Tile as a repair condition on every startup and delete it before advancing the managed scene version, so a prior failed deletion cannot strand a bright/green tile artifact permanently.

checks.name: Stale floor tile forces repair
checks.run: grep -q 'const needsObsoleteFloorCleanup = managedFloorTiles.length > 0;' scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs && grep -q '!needsObsoleteFloorCleanup' scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs

checks.name: Cleanup happens before scene version update
checks.run: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs','utf8'); const d=s.indexOf('await target.deleteEmbeddedDocuments(\"Tile\"'); const u=s.indexOf('await target.update(update)'); if(d<0||u<0||d>u) throw new Error('cleanup ordering regression');"
